accumulator: float64 sums, second moments and extrema; uint32 counts; FP32 output
comparable: inside, positive target and source expected camera-Z, valid opacity at or above 0.01 at both pixels, and available source pair

definitions.angle_max: maximum observation-ray angle in radians among comparable sources
definitions.angle_mean: mean target/source observation-ray angle in radians among comparable sources
definitions.angle_std: population standard deviation of observation-ray angle among comparable sources
definitions.available_query_fraction: queried IDs with both original-photo-derived RGB and self-render / queried IDs
definitions.colour_conflict_support_fraction: supported sources with target/photo MAE above 0.10 / supported count
definitions.log_library_size: log1p(unique accessible source identities, including declared unavailable members)
definitions.log_query_size: log1p(unique queried source identities, including selected unavailable members)
definitions.photo_mae_mean: mean absolute target-to-source photo RGB residual among finite depth-supported colours
definitions.photo_mae_min: minimum target-to-source photo residual among finite depth-supported colours
definitions.photo_mae_std: population standard deviation of target-to-source photo residual among finite depth-supported colours
definitions.query_library_fraction: queried unique IDs / unique accessible IDs
definitions.relative_depth_max: maximum relative camera-Z residual among comparable sources
definitions.relative_depth_mean: mean absolute camera-Z difference / max(Z_projected, Z_source, 1e-6) among comparable sources
definitions.relative_depth_std: population standard deviation of relative camera-Z residual among comparable sources
definitions.self_mae_max: maximum original-photo versus same-checkpoint self-render RGB residual among finite comparable colours
definitions.self_mae_mean: mean original-photo versus same-checkpoint self-render RGB residual among finite comparable colours
definitions.source_alpha_mean: mean source opacity among comparable sources
definitions.target_local_depth_range: 3x3 positive target camera-Z range divided by centre Z, minimum three valid samples
definitions.target_local_rgb_mae: 3x3 mean display-RGB channel MAE to centre, minimum three valid samples

missing_encoding: NaN numeric value and 1 in corresponding flag; an empty count is zero
normalization_scope: counts and ratios use the denominators named in each feature; no historical model clipping
projection: OpenCV integer pixel-centres, floor(u+0.5), fixed scene coordinate frame
risk_domain: finite target RGB and evaluable target geometry, with at least one available queried source pair; comparable_count may be zero

rules.residual: mean supported photo MAE, 1.0 when no finite supported colour

support: comparable and both opacities >=0.5 and relative camera-Z residual <=0.10
